Elections
Elections, General Elections Information
BUSINESS HOURS
The Auditors Office is open Monday through Friday from 8:00 a.m. until 4:30 p.m.
WHERE WE ARE LOCATED
The County Auditor's office is located in the Roseau County Courthouse in the Room 160 Office Suites.
WHAT WE DO
The Auditor in Roseau County is Martha (Martie) Monsrud. The responsibilities of the Auditor's office include the following:
PROPERTY RECORDS and TAXATION
Calculates proposed and final tax rates and taxes due based on the levy request certified by the county, cities, townships, school districts, and special taxing districts
Maintains the tax roll through updates to property ownership, splits and combinations, and transfers
Prepares the Truth in Taxation notices and Property Tax Statements for every taxable real and personal property in the county
Maintains special assessments for the county, cities, townships and special taxing districts and applies payments for collection
Administers ditch assessments for the county
Administers Tax Increment Financing and JOBZ as it pertains to tax calculation
Prepares tax certificates and tax searches
Provides tax record information to realtors and mortgage companies
Conducts Tax Forfeited Land Sales on behalf of the county
ACCOUNTING and BUDGET
Serves as the central accounting office for the county
Provides for the timely and accurate financial information that is provided to the many internal and external users
Processes the accounts payable for most funds and the revenues for all funds
Coordinates and prepares the annual budget
Coordinates the annual audit activities
Prepares financial statement summary for publication
Coordinates and compiles listing of fixed assets
Coordinates risk management and insurance records for the county
PAYROLL and BENEFITS
Processes payroll for all county departments
Maintains payroll system database
Administers employee benefits
ELECTION ADMINISTRATION
Serves as Chief Election Office for the county
Oversees voter registration and maintains the State Voter Registration system data base for Roseau County
Receives candidate filings
Oversees campaign finance reporting
Conducts absentee voting for State, Federal, and County elections
Trains election judges, head judges, and health care facility judges
Orders ballots and supplies for all precincts
Prepares ballots
Conducts public accuracy tests for election equipment
Compiles election results
Provides election related information to the public for State, Federal, and Local elections
Conducts canvass of State, Federal, and County elections
LICENSING
Issues licenses for retail sales of liquor, beer, and tobacco; and auctioneers
SCHOOL RECORDS
The school records can be obtain and review at: Roseau County Historical Society at 218-463-1918.
